label: sparse negative candidate at <DEL> step and on q inputs (content-dependent, unexplained)
explanation: Active on ~1% of steps. 62% of activation mass is on the delimiter step (rate 7% there, 7.4x lift) and ~20% on steps whose input is q (mostly early copy steps); the delimiter OR q predicate covers 82% of mass but precision is only 7%. Which delimiter steps fire depends on sequence content: higher when h was seen earlier or first token is w/q/t/k, and for longer sequences (t=8,9), but these conditions only reach precision ~0.18-0.35 with low recall. Never fires at t=0, rarely in the original phase. No coherent predicate found (best F1 ~0.23).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=1 & prev_tok=h (+7.02), t=2 & prev_tok=h (+4.35), in_tok=q (+4.23), in_tok=1 (+2.81), orig2=h (+2.23), out_tok=w (+2.16). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-4.74), in_tok=k (-4.08), in_tok=d (-3.68), in_tok=r (-3.66).
